name: Let's Relax Spa Bangkok (Sukhumvit 39)
nameZh: 乐放松水疗·曼谷素坤逸39巷
tagline: Award-winning Thai spa chain in the heart of Sukhumvit
taglineZh: 获奖连锁水疗，素坤逸核心地段
description: Let's Relax Spa's Sukhumvit 39 branch offers the brand's full menu of Thai massage, aromatherapy and signature packages in a sleek urban setting. Ideal after a day of shopping or sightseeing, with online booking and multiple branches citywide.
descriptionZh: Let's Relax Spa 素坤逸39巷店提供全套泰式按摩、香薰理疗与招牌套餐，都市感十足。逛街观光后放松的绝佳选择，支持在线预约，全城多分店。

location.address: 26/7 Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110

name: Oasis Spa Bangkok (Sukhumvit 31)
nameZh: 绿洲水疗·曼谷素坤逸31巷
tagline: A secret garden spa in the middle of the city
taglineZh: 都市中心的秘密花园水疗
description: Hidden behind lush greenery off Sukhumvit 31, Oasis Spa Bangkok feels a world away from the city. Private treatment rooms with open-air baths, couples' suites and skilled therapists make it one of the capital's most romantic spa escapes.
descriptionZh: 绿洲水疗隐于素坤逸31巷的葱郁绿植之后，宛如世外桃源。带露天浴池的私人理疗室、双人套房与娴熟手法，是曼谷最浪漫的水疗秘境之一。

location.address: 31/1 Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110

name: Divana Scentuara Spa
tagline: Colonial-era mansion spa near the Grand Palace
taglineZh: 大皇宫附近殖民风老宅水疗
description: Set in a restored colonial mansion surrounded by gardens in old Rattanakosin, Divana Scentuara offers fragrant flower-themed treatments, from petal baths to aromatherapy rituals, just minutes from the Grand Palace and Khao San Road.
descriptionZh: Divana Scentuara 坐落于老城区一栋殖民风格老宅中，花园环绕。主打芬芳花卉主题疗程——花瓣浴、香薰仪式等，距大皇宫与考山路仅几分钟车程。

location.address: 36/1 Samsen Rd, Wat Sommanat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100
